buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Actual delivery (and Installation & Commissioning (if covered in scope of supply)) is to be done at following address

ICAR-NIHSAD ANAND NAGAR KOKATA BY PASS BHOPAL MADHYA PRADESH . 3. Service & Support Availability of Service Centres: Bidder/OEM must have a Functional Service Centre in the State of each Consignee's Location in case of carry-in warranty. (Not applicable in case of goods having on-site warranty). If service center is not already there at the time of bidding, successful bidder / OEM shall have to establish one within 30 days of award of contract. Payment shall be released only after submission of documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre. 4. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 5. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 6. Generic Bidders shall quote only those products (Part of Service delivery) in the bid which are not obsolete in the market and has at least 1 years residual market life i.e. the offered product shall not be declared end-of- life by the OEM before this period. 7. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 8. Certificates ISO 9001: The bidder or the OEM of the offered products must have ISO 9001 certification. 9. Turnover Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 10. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing Commissioning of Goods and Training of operators and providing Statutory Clearances required (if any) 12. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses

The participants in the bid has to quote rates in financial bi d keeping the view of Buy Back. FINANCIAL BID DOCUMENT AS UPLOADED IN EXCEL SHOULD BE FILLED AND SUBMITTED ALONG WITH FINANCIAL BID. 1. Bidder Eligibility Criteria. a. Manufacturer Authorization Form The bidder must an OEM or shall provide a valid Manufacturer’ s Authorisation from the OEM. b. Past Experience: The bidder must have successfully executed at least two similar projects (Supply / Supply Installation of 30 Fire Extinguishers in single order of any type) in Government / Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs)/Private reputed industries/Hospitals/Institutions/shopping malls etc, during last 3 financial years (2023-26) c. Turnover: The bidder must have a minimum annual turnover of ₹20 Lakhs in each of the last three ( 3) financial years (2023-26). d. Local Service Centre: The bidder must have a functional service centre or office in the Madhya Pra desh to ensure prompt post-installation service and refilling. e. Quality Certification: All products must be BIS/ ISI marked and the bidder must upload copies of valid ISI licenses for each category of extinguisher. CE / EN 3-7 & 8/ UL should be uploaded where it is asked. f. Catalogue: Quotation shall be submitted along with printed technical literature/ catalogue of the quo ted make/ model of the fire extinguisher. 2. Scope of Work (Supply + Installation). a. The price quoted must include the cost of the extinguisher, transportation, and complete installation ( mounting). b. The bidder shall provide heavy-duty, MS powder-coated wall brackets, fasteners, and screws. c. The bidder must perform drilling and secure mounting at locations designated by the site-in-charge, adhering to IS 15683 height and safety standards. Each extinguisher must be tagged with an inspection card showing the date of insta llation and the next due date for service/refilling. 3. Buy Back Details 4. Other Terms & Conditions. a. All the items shall be quoted as per mentioned technical specifications. The bidder m ust mention the make of the items in the compliance sheet. b. The bidder shall quote rates inclusive of all taxes, installation charges, and the buy-b ack value of the existing fire extinguishers listed. c. The makes mentioned in the technical specification will only be considered for techni cal evaluation. d. Due care is taken to not include financial bid in the Technical bid. Financial bid and Te chnical Bid are two separate documents. e. Only technically suitable bids will be considered for financial evaluation. f. A comprehensive on-site service of at least 5 years is required for each type of fire e xtinguishers. Any leakage or pressure drop during this period must be fixed by the bidd er at no extra cost. g. After successful installation, the bidder must conduct a live demonstration/training se ssion for the staff on how to use the extinguishers (PASS method).

h. All fire extinguishers must be brand new. Refurbished or old stock manufactured mor e than 6 months prior to the bid date will be rejected. i. For CO2 and high-pressure units, PESO (Petroleum and Explosives Safety Organ ization) certificates must be provided for each cylinder. j. For the F500 EA-category (Battery Fire Extinguishers), the bidder must furnish UL Cer tificate of agent. k. All products must be BIS/ISI marked and the bidder must upload copies of valid ISI licenses for each category of extinguisher. i. Hydraulic Pressure Test Report for each fire extinguisher shall be provided by the bidder.
